name: event_planner
description: Large React Native event planning & social gatherings app refactoring (~17K tokens) with event browsing, RSVP management, calendar view, category filtering, search, map/location display, attendee lists, event creation modal, notifications, and user profiles. First mobile (appType: mobile) refactoring fixture — tests that the agent can correctly decompose a complex React Native screen with ScrollView, FlatList, modal workflows, and deeply interconnected state into smaller, well-structured modules while preserving all functionality.
